name: BNY
legalName: The Bank of New York Mellon Corporation
description: BNY is a custody bank: it holds and services other institutions' financial assets rather than lending to consumers. At December 31, 2025 it had $59.3 trillion of assets under custody and/or administration (AUC/A) and $2.18 trillion of assets under management. Clients (asset managers, pension funds, banks, corporations, broker-dealers) pay recurring fees for safekeeping, fund accounting, corporate trust and depositary-receipt services, securities clearing, collateral management, payments and brokerage clearing through Pershing, and management fees on assets run in its investment and wealth units. The other big earner is net interest income (24.6 percent of 2025 revenue) on the client cash deposits that pile up in custody and payments, invested in securities. Fees were 72 percent of 2025 total revenue, so revenue rises with market values and client activity and, on the interest side, with rates.

employees.note: Approximately 48,100 full-time employees (FY2025 10-K; 51,800 at 2024-12-31, 53,400 at 2023-12-31). About 60% of total employees (full and part-time) are based outside the US.

businessLines.name: Securities Services
businessLines.shareBasis: 9,730 / 20,046 consolidated segment-basis total revenue; the 10-K's GAAP total is $20,080M, the $34M difference being income attributable to noncontrolling interests in consolidated investment funds (Note 23)
businessLines.how: Asset owners, asset managers and corporate clients pay fees for safekeeping their securities worldwide, fund accounting, fund administration and transfer agency, and for trustee, paying-agent and depositary-receipt services; BNY also earns net interest income on the client deposits it holds (average deposits $184.4B in FY2025), securities lending revenue and foreign exchange revenue. Revenue rises with assets held ($43.0 trillion of AUC/A in this segment), client activity and interest rates.
businessLines.description: Asset Servicing (custody, fund accounting, fund administration, middle office and related services for asset managers, asset owners and banks; revenue $7,516M) and Issuer Services (corporate trust and depositary receipts; revenue $2,214M).

revenue.note: Segment total revenue, FY2024 $8,916M (+9%); includes net interest income $2,710M, investment services fees $5,743M, foreign exchange revenue $596M, other fees $266M and investment and other revenue $415M (FY2025 annual report, exhibit 13 to 10-K)

businessLines.revenueNote: Segment total revenue, FY2024 $8,916M (+9%); includes net interest income $2,710M, investment services fees $5,743M, foreign exchange revenue $596M, other fees $266M and investment and other revenue $415M (FY2025 annual report, exhibit 13 to 10-K)

operatingProfit.note: Income before income taxes; FY2024 $2,564M. Pre-tax operating margin 33% (29% in 2024).

businessLines.name: Market and Wealth Services
businessLines.how: Pershing charges broker-dealers, wealth managers and registered investment advisors for execution, clearing, custody and technology; Payments and Trade earns fees and deposit spread on payments, liquidity management and trade finance for financial institutions, corporates and the public sector; Clearance and Collateral Management earns fees for clearing and settling equity and fixed-income trades and for holding tri-party repo collateral (BNY is the primary provider of US government securities clearance per the annual report). Net interest income on client deposits is a major part ($2,096M of $7,000M).
businessLines.description: Pershing (clearing, custody and technology for broker-dealers and wealth advisers; revenue $2,928M), Payments and Trade (formerly Treasury Services; revenue $2,001M) and Clearance and Collateral Management (revenue $2,071M).

revenue.note: FY2024 $6,264M (+12%); total fee and other revenue $4,904M and net interest income $2,096M

businessLines.revenueNote: FY2024 $6,264M (+12%); total fee and other revenue $4,904M and net interest income $2,096M

operatingProfit.note: Income before income taxes; FY2024 $2,892M. Pre-tax operating margin 49% (46% in 2024).

businessLines.name: Investment and Wealth Management
businessLines.how: Institutional and retail clients pay investment management fees on assets under management, with occasional performance fees (only $3M in Q2 2026), so revenue moves with market values and net flows; wealth clients pay for investment management, custody, estate planning and private banking. Wealth Management has $350B in client assets.
businessLines.description: Investment Management (revenue $2,197M) manages assets for institutions and distributors; Wealth Management (revenue $1,061M) serves high-net-worth individuals, families and endowments.

revenue.note: FY2024 $3,389M (-4%); segment-basis revenue is net of $34M attributable to noncontrolling interests in consolidated investment funds. 28% of segment revenue came from non-US sources in 2025 (30% in 2024).

businessLines.revenueNote: FY2024 $3,389M (-4%); segment-basis revenue is net of $34M attributable to noncontrolling interests in consolidated investment funds. 28% of segment revenue came from non-US sources in 2025 (30% in 2024).

operatingProfit.note: Income before income taxes; FY2024 $605M (-10%). Pre-tax operating margin 17% (18% in 2024).

businessLines.name: Other segment
businessLines.how: Not a client business: it holds items not pushed to the three segments, including gains and losses on the securities portfolio and other investments.
businessLines.description: Corporate items, securities portfolio management (a shared service) and leftover items.
